title: ESQ-Bench：面向企业Oracle数据库的NL2SQL方言泛化与静默语义分歧评估基准
summary: ESQ-Bench是一个面向企业Oracle数据库的NL2SQL基准，包含三个复杂度层级、六个填充模式（465表、164,682行）、四个评估指标和550个金标准问答对。评估显示GPT-4o和Claude Sonnet 4.6在层级上表现下降，静默分歧率高，而开源模型Llama 3.2表现不佳，凸显了企业级方言泛化的挑战。
summary_en: ESQ-Bench is an Oracle-first NL2SQL benchmark with complexity tiers, six populated schemas, four metrics, and 550 gold QA pairs. Evaluation shows performance degradation and high silent divergence for GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 4.6, while open-weight Llama 3.2 lags, highlighting enterprise dialect generalization challenges.
